doctrine: Provisional (brief section 6.2): a centralized administrative and military occupation faction built on ports, roads, forts, standardized production, taxation, artillery and external supply. Proposed strengths: disciplined forces, fortification, artillery, standardization, ports, major-road logistics, administrative control, external reinforcement. Proposed weaknesses: rigid command, expensive occupation, long supply chains, isolated garrisons, dependence on ports and formal routes, and resistance by local populations. Prose only; nothing in the strategy tree may branch on it before S15.
victory_conditions: Provisional (brief section 6.2 proposed victory pressure): convert the island into governable, taxable, militarily controlled territory connected to external authority. Not an ordinary-faction victory condition -- brief section 20 leaves those Open.
